policy.strong_answer: Canonical answer plus a safety notice when high-risk terms are detected.
policy.uncertain_agriculture: State B disclosure, clarification request, and canonical suggestions; no fabricated answer.
policy.off_topic: State C agricultural scope explanation and topic recovery path; no agricultural answer.
policy.human_review_limit: Automated checks measure structure, routing, language, and safety-notice coverage. Agronomic correctness and Twi naturalness still require qualified human review.
